name: Challenge – Manage and Display Online Challenges
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Online Challenge management plugin for WordPress. Challenge plugin allows users to easily join and participate in various challenges. Users can access detailed information about the challenges, track their progress, and view results upon completion. With a user-friendly interface, this plugin provides an engaging experience, motivating users to achieve their goals.

How to use

  • Install the Challenge plugin.
  • Use the provided shortcode wherever you need.

  • Let users start their journey with new challenges!

  • For installation help, click on the Installation tab.

sections.installation:
From Gutenberg Editor:

  1. Go to the WordPress Block/Gutenberg Editor.
  2. Search for Challenge.
  3. Click on Challenge to add the block.

Download & Upload:

  1. Download the **Challenge ** plugin (.zip file).
  2. In your admin area, go to the Plugins menu and click on Add New.
  3. Click on Upload Plugin, choose the challenge.zip file, and click on Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin and start managing challenges!

Manually:

  1. Download and upload the Challenge ** plugin to the **/wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Do I need to set up anything?

No setup is required. Just use the shortcode wherever you want to enable challenges.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it works with any standard WordPress theme.

How many times can I reuse this?

You can use it as many times as you want.

Where can I get support?

You can post your questions on the support forum here.
